description: ACCDB: CREATE TABLE T(ID LONG PK, D DATETIME2) + CREATE INDEX IX_D ON T(D) + CREATE INDEX IX_DD ON T(D DESC). Inserts boundary values (0001-01-01, 0001-01-02 01:02:03.1234567, 1899-12-30, 2026-03-05 13:45:01.1234567, .1234568, 9999-12-31, Null) via SQL literals (IDs 1..7) and matching values via DAO AddNew ISO string & VT_DATE (IDs 11..15). Keeps all pages (exact 42-byte rows & 55-byte ASC/DESC keys); tests ORDER BY D / D DESC, index walks on IX_D & IX_DD, and DAO table Seek on IX_D with ISO string and VT_DATE.
